question: Is the teacher-dependent wholly dependent, and initiation alone enough?
premises: teacher-dependent indeed in enjoyment and liberation, in every way
and initiation alone, even without knowledge
one's own inner — releases indeed, so said
inference: Total teacher-dependence; bare initiation releases even knowledge-less.
plain_english: Teacher-dependent indeed in enjoyment and liberation, in every way — and initiation alone, even without knowledge of one's own inner, releases indeed, so said.
